set_desc: SWE-bench Pro chains: SWE-bench Pro tasks chained together into longer tasks that start to reflect real coding work. 13 chains × 2 trials, run on every tool (130 runs).
set_tested: 13 chains of dependent SWE-bench Pro tasks in one repository (ansible, flipt, navidrome, nodebb, openlibrary, qutebrowser, teleport, vuls, webclients), each run twice per tool. A run passes only if every task in the chain passes. Claude Sonnet 5.5 (high effort) in Claude Code 2.1.293. Tool versions: graphify 0.9.95, ponytail 5.3.2, caveman upstream 1f951fb (CAVEMAN_DEFAULT_MODE=caveman), rtk 1.0.1.
interpretation_note: Note on interpretation: cost differences between conditions include everything the model does differently when a tool is active (extra turns, extra tool calls, sub-agent delegation). Delegation to sub-agents is model behaviour that a tool can change; it is not a benchmark setting or an error, and no cost difference in this file is attributed to it. A difference whose 95% range (change_ci_low to change_ci_high) includes 0 could be noise and is not a confirmed difference.
